title: Japanese Sesame Cabbage Salad
description: Built during a cooking session rather than from a fixed recipe card, so treat the amounts as a starting point.

confidence.note: Built live. Built during a cooking session rather than from a fixed recipe card, so treat the amounts as a starting point.

items.note: A splash more if skipping the sesame oil
Or a little red onion soaked in cold water 5–10 min to mellow

steps.text: Shred the cabbage ({{cabbage}}). In the Thermomix, use the butterfly and pulse in short 2–3 sec bursts at Speed 4, in batches, with the bowl no more than half full.
Toast the sesame seeds ({{sesame}}) in a dry pan 2–3 minutes until fragrant. Worth doing if you are leaving out the sesame oil.
Toss the cabbage with the vinegar ({{vinegar}}), sesame oil ({{sesame-oil}}) if using, sesame seeds, onion and a pinch of salt.
Taste and adjust. A little more vinegar brightens it if there is no sesame oil.
